title.title: Police 24/7
title.overview: This adrenaline-packed series delivers raw, unfiltered access into the world of sheriffs and police departments across the United States as they serve and protect at all costs. From drug busts to routine traffic stops, you never know what to expect, but these officers are ready 24/7 to keep their communities safe.

episodes.name: The Chase
episodes.overview: Suspects lead police on a car chase then a foot chase through houses. Officers apply first aid to a gunshot victim and arrest his roommate.

episodes.name: Three Stops You're Out
episodes.overview: A stolen truck leads police on a dangerous high-speed chase; a speeder gives the police an earful; a disgruntled mom picks up her drunk son.

episodes.name: Close Shave
episodes.overview: A teen driver takes officers on a wild, stolen car pursuit; two men are suspected of stealing thousands of dollars of razors; a domestic call leads to a double arrest.

episodes.name: Patients and Patience
episodes.overview: A call to a shooting leads to a scuffle and a lost gun; an officer must clear squatters from an abandoned house; an angry passenger does not appreciate getting a ride home.

episodes.name: Into the Woods
episodes.overview: A multi-officer manhunt through a swamp; a double homicide at a hotel leave officers looking for a suspect on the loose; a woman lost in Florida tries to find her way back to New York.

episodes.name: On the Run
episodes.overview: Officers search for four men involved in a shooting; an officer tries to help a woman and her three children looking for shelter; two men are arrested after an accident downs powerlines.

episodes.name: Outrunning the Law
episodes.overview: A man in the woods is interrogated after his actions draw attention from a nearby school; two men get lucky as they find out their warrants have just expired; a distraught man gets pulled over on suspicion of a DUI.

episodes.name: You Again
episodes.overview: Flagler utilizes their SWAT equipment to infiltrate a known drug house; a car pursuit leads to the arrest of a man detained on the suspicion of ditching meth; officers pull over a man for a DUI for the second night in a row.

episodes.name: Tape It Off
episodes.overview: Police find a woman covered in blood near a man that’s been shot; A stolen car is recovered from a yard across town; Police respond to a domestic dispute involving an elderly man.

episodes.name: Man's Best Friend
episodes.overview: A K-9 unit helps lead a manhunt; A property dispute between a squatter and a motel next door; A suspicious vehicle is searched and a felony level of MDMA is discovered.

episodes.name: Foiled again
episodes.overview: Police negotiate with a suspect barricaded in his bedroom; motel occupants fail to convince police that the found paraphernalia isn't theirs; a mishap involving a toy gun has potential deadly consequences

episodes.name: Credit cards with charges
episodes.overview: Police attend to a melee at the gas station involving a golf club; a shoplifter is caught with several IDs and credit cards not belonging to her. A DUI suspect recognizes one of the arresting officers.

episodes.name: Sweet Justice
episodes.overview: Police struggle to remove an overdosing motel occupant; a river rescue proves challenging to local police; a high-speed motorcycle chase leads to a sad confession by the rider.

episodes.name: Locked and Loaded
episodes.overview: Police respond to a tip of a suspect hiding out in a hotel; a suspect's auntie gives controversial advice to her nephew; a backyard dwelling gator gets relocated by a team of police.

episodes.name: Bad day at the park
episodes.overview: Wilmington police investigate a late-night picnic gone wrong; police are forced to figure out a custody dispute in the middle of a crowded bar; police rescue an over-heated dog left in the car.

episodes.name: Run n' Gun
episodes.overview: A man on a motorcycle leads police on a high-speed, multi-state chase; police plot to stop a fleeing car; a traffic stop leads to suspects unsuccessfully trying to dispose of evidence.

episodes.name: Family Matters
episodes.overview: A traffic stop turns into a foot chase into the woods; a disgruntled boss works with police to get a former employee arrested; a daughter is forced to call the cops on her mom after an altercation.

episodes.name: Frisky Business
episodes.overview: A traffic stop leads to a drug arrest with the suspect hiding drugs in an unusual place; a shattered windshield leads to a domestic violence arrest; police are forced to subdue a man harassing and throwing laundry beads at people.

episodes.name: Crime After Crime
episodes.overview: A routine traffic stop uncovers a fugitive hiding in the back seat; police must figure out a way to get a disturbed man from on top a box truck; police must use discretion as a high-speed chase gets close to a school zone.

episodes.name: Naked Aggression
episodes.overview: Police are forced to deploy a taser while pursuing a suspect on foot; police help a man overdosing on the side of the road; police help reunite parents and their toddler at a corn maze; police on patrol must act quickly when they hear shots fired.

episodes.name: Jaws of Life
episodes.overview: A vehicle pursuit quickly turns to a rescue once the driver crashes; police contain a man in the throes of a drug trip; a late-night driver gets caught with prescriptions that aren't hers.

episodes.name: Side Swiped
episodes.overview: Police race to save a women suspected of overdosing; police kick down some doors in order to arrest a suspect; a man pleads for help from the police as he tries to resolve family issues; a driver accidentally runs his car into a store.

episodes.name: Small But Mighty
episodes.overview: A melee at a bar is broken up by two cops who also happen to be best friends; police call fire and EMS to a scene of a severely injured man; police dogs find a man suspected of a hit-and-run.

episodes.name: Too Much Whine
episodes.overview: Police track down suspects using dogs and drones; police deal with a drunk man causing problems in the neighborhood; police investigate a fight unclear if the victims are being forthright; while on patrol, police find a woman involved in an accident who's had too much to drink.

episodes.name: Food Fight
episodes.overview: A routine traffic stop escalates into a foot chase with a taser deployment; a dispute over food leads to an arrest over outstanding warrants; a recently released man gets arrested for a felonious amount of marijuana; a driver is unaware he's driving a stolen truck

episodes.name: You're in a Pickle
episodes.overview: Police find a man suspected in a domestic battery case hiding under a truck; police find a woman passed out drunk in her car; an officer finds himself in a dilemma concerning a man and a stolen gun.

episodes.name: Keep Testing Me, Man
episodes.overview: A crime prevention unit's car gets rammed by a fleeing stolen car; a suspicious group of people are found to have warrants and a squirrel; a homeless lady is warned to stop assaulting people; police pursue suspects relying on dogs and helicopters for help.

episodes.name: It's Not a Good Day Today
episodes.overview: A reported menacing call requires multiple police and dogs to resolve the situation; a man tries to get his car back from the impound yard; a security guard on a motorcycle tries to speed his way out of a bad day.

episodes.name: She's in the Washing Machine
episodes.overview: Police resort to extreme methods while trying to stop a fleeing suspect; an intoxicated man gets boxed in by police as he tries to drive away; police find suspects as they respond to a shots fired call.

episodes.name: On the Edge
episodes.overview: A woman is in the middle of a domestic dispute; a man threatens to jump off a building.

episodes.name: Do You Want to Pick Up a Felony?
episodes.overview: Police, with the help of canines, track down a suspect hiding in the woods; a traffic stop reveals hidden guns and drugs; police race to assist a woman who's been shot; a pregnant woman gets caught using a fake name.

episodes.name: I Got One Running
episodes.overview: A trespassing warning turns into a foot chase; a brawl breaks out between some bikers and locals; a 21-year-old with a crashed car tell police a dubious story; a reckless driver puts himself and others in danger.

episodes.name: Keep Your Eyes Open
episodes.overview: Rowdy teenagers cause problems at the local liquor store; a traffic stop yields both guns and drugs; a man creates a medical emergency by swallowing drugs right before his arrest.

episodes.name: I'm Sorry, Grandma
episodes.overview: A young man has instant regrets after getting stopped for stealing his grandma's car; a passer-by needs to be airlifted to a hospital after getting sideswiped by a car; neighbors accuse a man of indecent behavior leaving his sister in a difficult situation.

episodes.name: Get Down
episodes.overview: A traffic accident uncovers a prostitute and drug dealer up to no good; police respond to a man accused of brandishing a gun; a good Samaritan helps police revive a man suspected of having an overdose.

episodes.name: What in the World is This?
episodes.overview: Police pursue people suspected of throwing rocks at passing cars; officers respond to a domestic violence call with a gun involved; an officer witnesses a car accident and assists with the rescue.

episodes.name: Rocky Relationship
episodes.overview: The police's search for a stolen car leads to a foot chase; gun shots at a football game create chaos; police deal with a situation involving a lady with illegal drugs and cancer; and elderly man suffers from a panic attack as he confronts the man that tried to steal his bike.

episodes.name: I Don't Think It's Crazy
episodes.overview: Police investigate a drive-by shooting at an apartment building; a homeless man is stopped for smoking fentanyl; a suspicious car leads to a drug arrest; police pursue a woman suspected of stealing a car.

episodes.name: Where Y'all Headed?
episodes.overview: A routine traffic stop turns into a foot pursuit; a man suspected of throwing knives is questioned by police; a hotel calls police to help with a non-cooperative man not wanting to leave the property.

episodes.name: That's My Wife
episodes.overview: Police pursue a man recklessly driving a motorcycle; officers coordinate with each other to pin in a suspected stolen car; police respond to a traffic accident involving an injured woman; police investigate a suspicious man going door to door asking for help getting his car unstuck.

episodes.name: We're Not Doing That!
episodes.overview: A combative driver provides officers with suspicious information and then attempts to flee; a neighbor tips off officers that a wanted suspect just got home; a domestic violence call leads to an investigation where police must figure out who to charge.

episodes.name: Too Many Coincidences for Me
episodes.overview: A traffic stop for improper use of center lane turns into a chase; a 911 call leads to officers helping a woman who stabbed herself; a speeding driver complains to officers of unusual health problems.

episodes.name: Nice Try
episodes.overview: Officers pullover a car containing a subject wanted for firearms and explosives; a traffic violation leads to an arrest of a man with contortionist skills; a wild hog making a mess gets the attention of the police.

episodes.name: I'm Not Asking You
episodes.overview: A speeding vehicle causes a head on collision with another cop car; a man with cancer is found with copious amounts of weed; police are forced to deploy a taser on a difficult suspect.

episodes.name: Don't Do Nothing Dumb
episodes.overview: Multiple officers are needed to arrest a fleeing suspect; suspected shoplifters second guess their decisions; a traffic stop leads to seizure of a hidden gun.

episodes.name: She's Breathing
episodes.overview: A driver loses her battle with the side of a building; police use a pin maneuver to neutralize a couple suspected of stealing a truck; police rush to save a citizen suspected of having a overdose.

episodes.name: Let Me See Your Hands
episodes.overview: Police figure out a dispute between the owner of a car and a tow yard; a traffic stop leads to the seizure of a machine gun and drugs; police find more than they bargained for in an abandoned house.

episodes.name: I Didn't Do Nothing
episodes.overview: A fleeing driver leads police on a chase through the woods; a repeat offender violates his trespass order; an intense storm adds difficulty to police investigating a shooting.

episodes.name: Hands Behind Your Back
episodes.overview: King County officers coordinate to stop a man carrying multiple knives; officers work with citizens to save an overdosed man; an intoxicated man gives officers a tough time about leaving a bus stop.

episodes.name: Sorry
episodes.overview: Police investigate a driver that’s asleep at the wheel; police track down a stolen car; several police are needed to apprehend a man with barricaded in a house.

episodes.name: I Know My Rights
episodes.overview: Police must figure out the rightful owner of a stolen bike; a pizza delivery man suffers serious injuries while on the job; a drunk man goes home to the wrong house.

episodes.name: Is Today a Full Moon?
episodes.overview: Several officers are needed to break up a block party; officers crack the case on a shoplifting scheme; Beaverton officers deal with a very intoxicated man.

episodes.name: Hot Pursuit
episodes.overview: Chasing down a suspect can be dangerous. This special episode of "Police 24/7" focuses on law enforcement’s strategies and tactics during pursuits and apprehension.

episodes.name: Search and Seizure
episodes.overview: This special episode focuses on items that law enforcement finds while searching suspects. From drugs to weapons, the streets are packed with hidden dangers.

episodes.name: Armed and Dangerous
episodes.overview: This special episode has firearms in its sights. Dealing with guns are part of the job for law enforcement. Police officers must use extreme caution to keep themselves and the street safe.

episodes.name: Busted
episodes.overview: Drugs play a part on most arrests. This special episode of "Police 24/7" focuses on how law enforcement deals with the growing problem of illegal substances on the streets.

episodes.name: Grand Theft Auto
episodes.overview: In the United States, over 2000 cars are stolen every day. This special episode of Police 24/7 gives us an inside look how law enforcement deals with this nationwide epidemic.

similar.title: The Long Pour
similar.overview: The Long Pour is a late 1920s New York Prohibition-era crime drama following the Italian-American Rinaldi family, who quietly control one of the city’s most sophisticated bootlegging empires. Led by Don Salvatore “Tore” Rinaldi, his wife, and his 5 sons, the family profits by maintaining and controlling Prohibition and carefully balancing supply, scarcity, and corruption to keep illegal alcohol highly lucrative.

similar.title: Mystery Files
similar.overview: Have you ever found yourself on a Wikipedia deep dive on the weird side of the internet? In this show, weird thing enthusiasts Ryan and Shane take turns presenting their latest fascinations to each other covering everything unusual, unexplained, and unhinged.

similar.title: Dirty Business
similar.overview: Two amateur detectives in an Oxfordshire village discover dying fish in their river. When they contact the water company for answers, the company's odd, evasive response prompts them to launch an investigation that continues today.

similar.title: Dimension 20
similar.overview: Heed the call of adventure and enter Dimension 20 where Game Master Brennan Lee Mulligan, joined by comedians and pro gamers, blends comedy with tabletop RPGs.
